title: Methodological Obstacles, API Deprecations, and Empirical Null-Results in Weak-Drive Coherence Anchoring on Superconducting Processors
description: Empirical evaluation and methodological null-result of the Quantum Anchor protocol on IBM Quantum (156-qubit Heron ibm_marrakesh) and IQM Resonance (20-qubit Garnet) superconducting processors. Evaluates API deprecations (removal of OpenPulse and analog IQ access), circuit-tautology traps, and empirical coherence noise floors across multi-qubit registers.
